今天的主题：家庭、代际和社区。这组词对 G 类很实用：大作文常考「老人该和子女住还是住养老院」「年轻人能从老一辈身上学到什么」；小作文可以写信给社区中心报名当志愿者；口语 Part 1 的 Family、Neighbours，Part 2「描述一位你尊敬的长辈」都能直接用。

例句

  • Many elderly people suffer from loneliness after their retirement.（很多老人退休后会感到孤独。）
  • Children who interact with older people learn patience and respect.（和老人互动的孩子能学会耐心和尊重。）
  • Older people can contribute a great deal of wisdom and experience to the community.（老人能给社区贡献很多智慧和经验。）
  • I would like to volunteer at the local nursery at weekends.（我想周末去本地幼儿园做志愿者。）
  • Such projects help to break down negative stereotypes about old age.（这类项目有助于打破对老年的负面刻板印象。）

过关标准：遮住中文看英文，能说出 22 个以上的意思，再挑 5 个自己造句（试试用 elderly、loneliness、community 写一句你对老人住养老院的看法，大作文能直接用）。

BBC 6 Minute English：Learning from different generations（向不同代际的人学习）。这是 11 月 12 日刚出的新一集。讲英国切斯特一家开在退休社区里的幼儿园，孩子和老人一起跳舞、做手工、折纸飞机；前飞行员 Ian 在妻子去世后靠这里「填补空缺」，创始人 Liz 还发现老人有时比孩子还闹腾。这集短、生词不多，比较好跟。音频和原文都已经放在页面里，不用打开 BBC 网站。

  1. 先把上面的听前生词过一遍，听不太懂可以先读懂原文再听。
  2. 第一遍不看文字，只听大意，回答开头的问题：1982 年出生的人属于哪一代？a) Generation X b) Millennial c) Gen Z。顺便听出：这家幼儿园在英国哪个城市？Ian 以前是做什么的？他教孩子们做什么？
  3. 第二遍点开下面的原文精听，听不出的地方暂停、倒回去并标出来。Ian 和 Liz Ludden 两段是真实采访录音，语速稍快，多听几遍。
  4. 第三遍挑 Ian 那段（"It was after my wife died last year..."）跟读，模仿语调和连读。
  5. 记住 6 个表达：generation（一代人）、fill a void（填补空缺）、such and such（某某）、hear on / from the grapevine（听到小道消息）、break down stereotypes（打破刻板印象）、lively（活泼热闹的）。
点开看原文（难词带中文，点虚线词显示）
💡 点击或悬停虚线词看中文；点击说话人名字可单独切换该段翻译

Phil：Hi Georgie.

Phil：嗨，乔治。

Georgie：Hi Phil.

Georgie：嗨，菲尔。

Phil：So, Georgie, do you often spend time with people who are much older than you or much younger than you?

Phil：乔治，你经常和比你大很多或者小很多的人待在一起吗？

Georgie：I do, actually, because I'm in a choir合唱团, so there's quite a wide range of各种各样的，范围很广的 ages – lots of older people, lots of younger people.

Georgie：其实是的，因为我在一个合唱团里，那里年龄跨度挺大，有很多年长的人，也有很多年轻人。

Phil：We can call an age group of people a generation一代人，世代. And you might feel that it's difficult to understand or agree with people from a different generation一代人，世代. Today on 6 Minute English, we're going to be finding out about a project that is gathering together把……聚到一起 the oldest people – that's those that are retired退休的 – with the youngest, and that's children who attend nursery幼儿园，托儿所. And we'll be asking the question, 'What can we learn from different generations一代人，世代?' Let's start with our quiz question, Georgie. What generation一代人，世代 would someone born in 1982 be in? Is it: a) Generation一代人，世代 X,
b) Millennial, or
c) Gen Z.

Phil：一个年龄段的人我们可以叫做一代人（generation）。你可能会觉得很难理解或认同另一代人。今天的《六分钟英语》我们要了解一个项目，它把最年长的人，也就是已经退休的人，和最年幼的人，也就是上幼儿园的孩子，聚到一起。我们还会探讨：我们能从不同代际的人身上学到什么？先来个小测验，乔治。1982 年出生的人属于哪一代？a) X 世代，b) 千禧一代，还是 c) Z 世代？

Georgie：Phil, I'm going to go with Generation一代人，世代 X.

Georgie：菲尔，我选 X 世代。

Phil：OK. Well, we will find out弄清楚，得知 the answer at the end of the programme.

Phil：好，节目最后揭晓答案。

Georgie：OK. Phil, so you said we're going to look at a project which gets small children interacting互动 with older retired退休的 people. So, how does it work?

Georgie：好。菲尔，你说我们要看一个让小孩和退休老人互动的项目，那它是怎么运作的？

Phil：Well, in Chester, in the northwest of England, a nursery幼儿园，托儿所 has opened up in a retirement village退休社区. There's the usual nursery幼儿园，托儿所 staff to look after the children, but the older residents居民 can join in参加 for activities as well. There's a library, a cafeteria自助餐厅 and a garden for the children and the older people to share, and some of the older people or 'grand-friends', as the children call them, lead some of the activities, like dance or crafts手工. And presenter of BBC World Service podcast People Fixing the World, Myra Anubi, went to visit the special nursery幼儿园，托儿所 and spoke to some of the participants参与者.

Phil：在英格兰西北部的切斯特，一家幼儿园开在了一个退休社区里。有普通的幼儿园老师照看孩子，但老年居民也可以参加活动。那里有图书馆、餐厅和花园，孩子和老人共用。有些老人，孩子们叫他们「爷爷奶奶朋友」，会带一些活动，比如跳舞或手工。BBC 国际台播客《改变世界的人》的主持人 Myra Anubi 去参观了这家特别的幼儿园，并采访了一些参与者。

Myra Anubi：Ian was once a fighter pilot战斗机飞行员, and getting involved in参与 the nursery幼儿园，托儿所 has helped him fill a void填补空缺.

Myra Anubi：伊恩曾经是一名战斗机飞行员，参与幼儿园的活动帮他填补了内心的空缺。

Ian：It was after my wife died last year. It seemed I had a big, big hole to fill. And the people down in the nursery幼儿园，托儿所, they phoned me up and said, "We were doing such and such某某 a thing. Why don't you come and join us?" And that's what I've been doing. So, yes, and I've enjoyed it. And I find it very interesting to see how they develop.

Ian：那是在我妻子去年去世以后。我感觉心里有个很大很大的窟窿要填。幼儿园那边的人给我打电话说：「我们在做某某活动，你要不要来一起？」我就一直这么参加了。是的，我很喜欢。看着孩子们成长，我觉得特别有意思。

Myra Anubi：One of the things I heard from the grapevine听到小道消息 is that you help the children make paper planes纸飞机.

Myra Anubi：我听说的一件事是，你会帮孩子们折纸飞机。

Ian：That's right.

Ian：没错。

Georgie：Myra says that the nursery幼儿园，托儿所 helped Ian fill a void填补空缺 after his wife sadly died. If you fill a void填补空缺, you find something to help you feel better after a loss.

Georgie：Myra 说，在伊恩的妻子不幸去世后，幼儿园帮他填补了空缺。fill a void 的意思是，在失去某些东西之后找到能让自己好受一点的事。

Phil：Ian explains that after his wife died, staff at the nursery幼儿园，托儿所 would phone him to tell him about the daily activities, which he refers to称作，指的是 as such and such某某. And that's an expression that we use to talk about something without giving a specific example.

Phil：伊恩说，妻子去世后，幼儿园的工作人员会打电话告诉他每天的活动，他用 such and such（某某）来指代这些活动。这个说法用来提到某件事但不举具体例子。

Georgie：It sounds like Ian has enjoyed spending time with the children at the nursery幼儿园，托儿所, and Myra tells him she's heard from the grapevine听到小道消息 that he's been teaching the children to make paper planes纸飞机.

Georgie：听起来伊恩很享受和幼儿园孩子们在一起的时光。Myra 告诉他，她听小道消息说他在教孩子们折纸飞机。

Phil：Yes, hear from the grapevine听到小道消息 is an expression, meaning that something is a rumour传闻，谣言. And we also say, hear on the grapevine听到小道消息.

Phil：对，hear from the grapevine 是个习语，意思是听到的是传闻、小道消息。也可以说 hear on the grapevine。

Georgie：Well, this nursery幼儿园，托儿所 sounds like a really lovely project, Phil. What is the impact it's having on the older and younger people?

Georgie：这家幼儿园听起来真是个很棒的项目，菲尔。它对老人和孩子有什么影响呢？

Phil：Well, the charity慈善机构 Ready Generations一代人，世代, which runs the nursery幼儿园，托儿所, says it works with universities to study the effects of mixing generations一代人，世代 on health and wellbeing健康幸福, and they say they've seen positive results. And there have been studies around the world on projects that encourage different generations一代人，世代 to mix, and they found that they can help reduce loneliness孤独, improve how healthy and well people feel, and even boost促进，提升 learning and creativity创造力. People Fixing the World host Myra spoke to Liz Ludden, co-founder联合创始人 of the nursery幼儿园，托儿所 in Chester, about the differences that she's noticed since it opened.

Phil：运营这家幼儿园的慈善机构 Ready Generations 说，他们和大学合作，研究不同代际混在一起对健康和幸福感的影响，并且看到了积极的结果。世界各地也有很多研究关注鼓励不同代人交往的项目，发现这些项目能减少孤独感，改善人们的身心健康，甚至促进学习和创造力。主持人 Myra 采访了切斯特这家幼儿园的联合创始人 Liz Ludden，聊她在开园后注意到的变化。

Myra Anubi：And as I realised, these interactions互动 also seem to be breaking down stereotypes打破刻板印象.

Myra Anubi：我也意识到，这些互动似乎还在打破刻板印象。

Liz Ludden：Your first thought would be how lively活泼热闹的 and energetic精力充沛的 young children can be, and what we found is so can older people. And so sometimes, you know, it's the older people that we're saying, "Can we just calm this down让这安静下来 a little bit?"

Liz Ludden：你第一反应会想到小孩子多么活泼、精力多么充沛，但我们发现老人也一样。所以有时候，你知道吗，反而是老人们需要我们说：「咱们能稍微安静一点吗？」

Georgie：Myra says the nursery幼儿园，托儿所 breaks down stereotypes打破刻板印象. This means it provides evidence that common beliefs about a group of people are not true.

Georgie：Myra 说这家幼儿园打破了刻板印象。意思是它提供了证据，证明人们对某一群人的普遍看法并不正确。

Phil：For example, a stereotype刻板印象 about generations一代人，世代 is that younger people are lively活泼热闹的, meaning they're loud and have lots of energy, whereas older people are not that lively活泼热闹的.

Phil：比如关于代际的一个刻板印象是：年轻人很 lively，也就是吵闹、精力旺盛，而老人没那么有活力。

Georgie：Right. But in the nursery幼儿园，托儿所, Liz says it's often the older people who have lots of energy and are being noisy rather than the children. The staff even have to tell them to calm down安静下来，冷静 sometimes!

Georgie：对。但 Liz 说在幼儿园里，常常是老人精力充沛、吵吵闹闹，而不是孩子。工作人员有时甚至得让他们安静点！

Phil：So, Georgie, is that something that you found in your choir合唱团?

Phil：乔治，你在合唱团里也有这种感觉吗？

Georgie：Actually, yes. The older people in my choir合唱团 are big characters个性鲜明的人. It's often them who are dragging us all拖着我们大家 to the pub...!

Georgie：其实是的。我们合唱团的年长成员个性都很鲜明，常常是他们拉着我们大家去酒吧……！

Phil：OK. Georgie, I think it's time to look at the answer for that question. I asked if someone was born in 1982, which generation一代人，世代 would they be from?

Phil：好，乔治，该揭晓答案了。我问的是 1982 年出生的人属于哪一代？

Georgie：I said Generation一代人，世代 X.

Georgie：我说的是 X 世代。

Phil：OK. Well, actually, I'm afraid the answer was b) – they're a Millennial, just like you!

Phil：嗯，其实很遗憾，答案是 b），他们是千禧一代，跟你一样！

Georgie：Ah...! OK. Let's recap回顾 the vocabulary we learned in this programme, starting with generation一代人，世代, which is a group of people who are of a similar age.

Georgie：啊……好吧。我们来回顾一下今天学的词，先是 generation，指年龄相近的一群人，也就是一代人。

Phil：Fill a void填补空缺 means find something to help you feel better after experiencing loss.

Phil：fill a void 指经历失去之后，找到能让自己好受些的东西。

Georgie：Such and such某某 is a way to talk about something without giving a specific example.

Georgie：such and such 是提到某事但不举具体例子的说法，意思是「某某」。

Phil：If you hear something on the grapevine通过小道消息, you hear a rumour传闻，谣言.

Phil：hear something on the grapevine 指听到传闻、小道消息。

Georgie：The expression break down stereotypes打破刻板印象 means find evidence that common beliefs about a group of people are untrue.

Georgie：break down stereotypes 指找到证据，证明对某群人的普遍看法是错的，也就是打破刻板印象。

Phil：And lively活泼热闹的 means loud and with lots of energy.

Phil：lively 指热闹、精力充沛。

过关标准：不看原文能用中文说出这集讲了什么（幼儿园开在退休社区、Ian 的经历、研究发现的好处、老人比孩子还活泼），6 个表达都知道意思，Ian 那段能流利读下来。

小练习

  1. After her children moved out, she joined a choir to fill the ______.（空缺）
  2. I heard on the ______ that our manager is leaving.（小道消息）
  3. The project helps break ______ stereotypes about older people.（打破）
  4. My grandparents and I belong to different ______.（代）
  5. The party was very ______, with music and dancing all night.（热闹的）
  6. Studies show that mixing generations can reduce ______ among older people.（孤独）
点开看答案

开头那题选 b，1982 年出生的是千禧一代（Millennial），乔治选 X 世代，猜错了。幼儿园在切斯特（Chester），Ian 以前是战斗机飞行员，他教孩子们折纸飞机。填空：1. void 2. grapevine 3. down 4. generations 5. lively 6. loneliness

今天的小思考（为口语 Part 3 和大作文做准备）：What can young people learn from older people? 用英语说两三句：I think young people can learn ... / For example, ...。也可以想想：你小时候和爷爷奶奶或外公外婆关系怎么样？
